reference.title: Find schema-dependent Guided editor controls
reference.shortdesc: Guided editor shows only the controls supported by the selected Firefox schema.

section.title: Controls in current schemas
section.p: On Release 153 and ESR 153.0, Step 5 can show supported AI and smart-feature, visual-search, and smart-browser policies.

section.title: Controls unavailable on ESR
section.p: On ESR 140.13, unsupported browser AI-policy controls are absent or unavailable. Do not add them manually as if Guided editor supported them.

section.title: Separate from the documentation assistant
section.p: This reference explains existing Firefox browser policy controls only. Those controls do not configure, enable, or restrict the separate documentation assistant.

section.title: Recovery
section.p: If a control is missing, confirm the schema channel, check All settings for the raw support boundary, and record the unsupported state during review.
